# The Wellness Advocate

> Advocating Your Health. Empowering Your Life. A telehealth-first, membership-based direct primary care practice serving patients located in Florida, based in Jacksonville. One provider, Aimee Roberts-Serrato, MSN, APRN, FNP-C, PMHNP-BC, a dual board-certified nurse practitioner, offers primary care, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (BHRT), and psychiatry and mental health care, without insurance billing.

Key facts:

- Model: direct primary care (DPC). Patients pay the practice a flat monthly membership fee instead of the practice billing insurance per visit. Membership is not insurance; it does not cover hospital care, emergency care, specialists, imaging or pharmacy prescriptions.
- Visits: telehealth across Florida, by appointment only, with flexible hours. There is no walk-in office yet. Based in Jacksonville.
- Licensing: Aimee is licensed in Florida; care is available to patients located in Florida.
- Pricing: Primary Care membership $69/month. Primary Care + BHRT membership $179/month. Psychiatry is added to a membership: initial evaluation $300, follow-up appointments $130. Every patient is enrolled in Primary Care.
- Provider: Aimee Roberts-Serrato, MSN, APRN, FNP-C, PMHNP-BC. Nurse Practitioner since 2016. Registered Nursing degree, Santa Fe College; Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Florida State College at Jacksonville; Master of Science in Nursing (Family Nurse Practitioner), University of Cincinnati, 2016; psychiatric mental health training, Florida State University, 2022; certification in Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy, Hormone Replacement Therapy University.
- Services: primary care; bioidentical hormone replacement therapy guided by lab work; psychiatric evaluation and medication management for adults.
- Booking and the patient portal run through OptiMantra.
- Not for emergencies: in a mental health crisis, call or text 988 (988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). For an emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.
- Website content is general information, not medical advice.
